description: Golf booking workflow (Gate 2 — Login Verification) aborted. Session expired on ChronoGolf. Attempted automatic login recovery via 1Password CLI, but 1Password command-line tool unavailable in sandbox environment. Cannot retrieve credentials securely.
correction: Login recovery requires either: (1) 1Password CLI restored in sandbox, or (2) manual authentication by David at ChronoGolf dashboard, or (3) credentials pre-cached in environment or passed via secure channel.
systemic_fix: Option A: Restore 1Password CLI in sandbox environment (requires system admin). Option B: Pre-populate credentials in secure environment variable instead of retrieving at runtime. Option C: Use browser-based 1Password fill integration instead of CLI. Escalate to system administrator to evaluate feasibility of each approach.
